title: feat(core,fields): a number field's authored useGrouping decides its thousands separator, relayed to every cell (objectui#11026)
body:
Fixes #11026
Clause-②: yes

The renderer half of `FieldSchema.useGrouping`, the digit-grouping hint `@objectstack/spec` declares on a field. A number field's authored `useGrouping` now decides its thousands separator, and every site that hand-copies `scale` into a cell's field relays it beside `scale`. This is the objectui end of objectstack-ai/objectstack#20313; that parent keeps the ledger flip.

## What changed

- **`@object-ui/core` `number-display.ts`**: `DisplayNumberFormatOptions` gains `useGrouping?: boolean`. `shouldGroupDisplayNumber(scale, currency, useGrouping)` is still the one decision point: an authored boolean answers first, in either direction (money included), and when it is unset the existing `scale`/`currency` heuristic decides, unchanged. There is no second heuristic.
- **The `Intl` note the card asked to mind.** The renderer still never writes `useGrouping: true` on its own behalf. The heuristic's "group" answer omits the key, so the locale's "auto" applies. The only `true` written is the author's own: the spec's docblock says the key "maps 1:1 onto `Intl.NumberFormat`'s `useGrouping` option", and its `true` means "the author pins grouping ON". So an authored `true` is "always". The difference only shows where a locale leaves a four-digit number alone under "auto": es-ES renders `1234` with the key unset and `1.234` with an authored `true`, and pl-PL renders `1 234`. This is pinned, with the premise asserted in the same test.
- **`@object-ui/types` `NumberFieldMetadata`** declares `useGrouping?: SpecField['useGrouping']`, derived by reference from the spec's type, as `dependsOn` already is. **This is a file-surface addition beyond the claim's list.** The dispatch said to read the key as the spec's type and not to cast around a missing key. The cell receives `FieldMetadata`, and without the declaration the only read would be through the existing `as any`.
- **`@object-ui/fields` `NumberCellRenderer`** reads `field.useGrouping` off the typed field. It narrows with `'useGrouping' in field`, so there is no cast, and it takes booleans only. It passes the value to `formatDisplayNumber`.
- **Relays**, each placed exactly where `scale` is copied (see the census below).
- Docs: `content/docs/fields/number.mdx` (the key in the schema snippet, plus a grouping table under Cell Renderer). Changeset: `.changeset/11026-number-use-grouping.md`.

## Relay census (re-derived, not copied from the card)

Instrument: `git grep -nE "\bscale\b" -- 'packages/*/src/**' ':!**/*.test.*' ':!**/__tests__/**'`, dropping comment lines and CSS/transform `scale`, then reading each hit. I also checked every consumer of `getCellRenderer` / `CellRenderer` under `packages/*/src` for how it builds the cell's `field`.

## Verification (all on `0d24f3624`)

- **Type-check**, rebuilding the dependency closure first (`pnpm --filter '@object-ui/plugin-grid^...' --filter '@object-ui/plugin-detail^...' --filter '@object-ui/plugin-list^...' build`, exit 0): `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/fields` all printed `type-check: Done`, exit 0. So did `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/plugin-list` (exit 0). Each chain includes `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, so the types pin's `Equal` assertions and its `@ts-expect-error` on a string `useGrouping` were compiled.
- **New pins**: 6 files, 32 tests passed.
- **Suites** (`pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 DIR` from the worktree root):
  - `packages/core/src/utils/`: 98 files, 1813 tests passed;
  - `packages/fields/src/`: 219 passed and 1 skipped (220 files), 3497 tests passed and 7 skipped;
  - `packages/plugin-list/src/`: 107 files, 1182 tests passed;
  - `packages/plugin-detail/src/`: 219 passed and 1 skipped (220 files), 2152 tests passed and 8 skipped;
  - `packages/plugin-grid/src/`: 166 files, 1550 tests passed;
  - `packages/types/src/`: 280 files, 6434 tests passed;
  - the i18n re-export pins (`number-display.test.ts`, `number-display.reexport-identity.test.ts`): 2 files, 18 tests passed. The i18n source is unchanged, but it re-exports the widened names.

  Each run printed `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The CLI tier split does not apply: no `packages/cli` file is touched.
- **Ablations**, each through `ablation-replace.mjs` (the anchor must hit, the blob change is checked on disk, and the restore is proven by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`). Vitest aliases `@object-ui/*` to `src`, so no dist rebuild sits between a mutation and its reading.
  - Delete the grid path A relay: 2 red (both path A hint rows), 8 green.
  - Delete the path B and C relays (anchor declared twice): 4 red (the B and C hint rows), 6 green. The controls and the auto-generated reference stay green on both legs, as predicted in the file header.
  - Delete `'useGrouping'` from `ENRICHED_FIELD_METADATA_KEYS`: DetailSection red, RecordDetailPanel and RelatedList green.
  - Delete the RecordDetailPanel copy: only RecordDetailPanel red.
  - Delete the RelatedList copy: only RelatedList red.
  - Delete the gallery copy: the gallery pin red.
  - Delete `useGrouping` from `NumberCellRenderer`'s formatter call: 13 red across the cell, grid, detail and gallery pins, including the grid's auto-generated reference; the 4 controls stay green.
  - Delete the authored-boolean line in `shouldGroupDisplayNumber`: 6 red.
  - Delete the authored-`true` spelling branch: only the es-ES and pl-PL "always" rows red.
- **eslint** on the 14 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files: 0 errors. The warning count on each of the 8 touched source files equals its count on the base, linted from `git show` (for example `ObjectGrid.tsx` has 209 on both). The two new `no-explicit-any` warnings are the `as any` fixture casts in two new test files. This is a narrowed run, not `pnpm lint`. The 14 files are the whole diff's TS population (`git diff --name-only`), and eslint's `--format json` output lists all 14, none of them ignored by the config. `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project`/`projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- **Gates**, all exit 0: `check-changeset-presence` ("14 source file(s) of 6 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)"), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers` / `-inherit` / `-override-shape`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids`. `check:changeset-claims` listed 10 pending changesets that name a file this diff touches. I read each named paragraph, and none makes a claim this diff falsifies.
- **NOT MEASURED: `check:doc-snippets`.** It exited 2 with PRECONDITION NOT MET: 22 of the 34 packages its program resolves against are unbuilt here, and that scoped build was not run locally. The one snippet this diff edits is a `NumberFieldMetadata` literal with `useGrouping: true`. The same annotated-literal shape compiles in the types pin (under `tsconfig.test.json`). CI runs the full gate.
- **Dist pins**: the dispatch lead named `plugin-grid`'s dist pins. The dist project's glob is `packages/*/src/**/*.dist.spec.tsx`, which matches two files, in `components` and `types`, and `plugin-grid` has none. The `types` one reads the zod subpath modules, which this diff does not touch (the new member is type-only). Not run locally; CI runs it.

## Acceptance notes

- `plugin-dashboard` `recordFields.tsx` `buildFieldMeta` copies neither `scale` nor `useGrouping`. So a number cell in the dashboard's object table and record drawer gets neither the scale-0 heuristic nor the author's hint. This is a read-only reading, not measured at a running door, so it is not filed. It is outside the card's "copies `scale`" census, so it is not relayed here. Carrier: none.
- `GridField` (the master-detail line grid) formats number cells with `toLocaleString`. It ignores the scale-0 heuristic and the hint alike. This is a read-only reading, not filed. Carrier: none.
- The spec's `FieldSchema.useGrouping` docblock describes today's interim heuristic as bound-sensitive ("`scale: 0` + no upper bound reads as a plain count and keeps grouping"). The renderer's heuristic is `scale === 0` alone, bounds unread. That is doc drift on the objectstack side. Carrier: the parent objectstack-ai/objectstack#20313 if it touches that docblock, otherwise none.
- The designer's field inspector offers no `useGrouping` control, so authoring it today means writing metadata by hand. This is an observation, not filed.
